verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail publishes check-deposit terms on its own page: a pay-per-deposit model with no setup or monthly fees, multi-check bundling savings, and a turnaround of 1 business day to mail out plus about a week for bank processing. The page implies the physical check is mailed to the bank, with express shipping available. Missing for 10: list of supported banks, actual per-deposit fee amounts, an explicit statement of what happens to the physical check after deposit (return or destruction), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward

citations.quote: Pay per deposit with no setup or monthly fees.
Check deposit requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day. Funds are usually processed by your bank within a week. Use express shipping to get paid even sooner.
Deposit multiple checks together for even greater savings!
